Axiom:
V2 file ownership and ticket identity must be structurally valid; ticket files must not collide on IDs; ticket section anchors must cover the names orchestrator queries.
Checks: - New or migrated V2 files in scope: `@file:` present; exactly one resolvable canonical `@spec:`; `@consumers:` present; legacy `@tasks:` absent. - `@consumers:` naming convention: value must be an entity name resolvable in the spec or codebase. File paths or directory names → `MINOR`. - Query each file through `gennady orient --file --json`; consume semantic-owner and task relations without reconstructing them. - Two ticket files declaring same Task-ID → `TASK_ID_DRIFT` (`BLOCKER`). - An unresolved/ambiguous owner, multiple active writers, active/spec mismatch, or forbidden V2 `@tasks` → `FILE_RELATION_DRIFT` with the exact `SDD_FILE_*` code from `sdd-check`. - **Ticket section-anchor coverage** (per scaffold `AX_TICKET_SECTION_NAMES_NORMATIVE`). For each ``-anchored name templated in `TASK_TICKET_STRUCTURE` invoke `npx gennady sdd-extract `. `AUDIT_ROUNDS` is a bare `## Audit Rounds` markdown heading, not a ``-anchored block (`TICKET_AUDIT_ROUND_FORMAT`) — check it with the heading-slug form `npx gennady sdd-extract #audit-rounds` instead; the `` form reports ANCHOR_NOT_FOUND even when the heading is genuinely present, because `sdd-extract` only matches `` markers for that form. Exit `2` (ANCHOR_NOT_FOUND/EMPTY) → `EXECUTION_LOG_INCOMPLETE` (`MAJOR`) tagged `missing-section-anchor`. Exit `3` (UNBALANCED/DUPLICATED) → `EXECUTION_LOG_INCOMPLETE` (`MAJOR`) tagged `anchor-unbalanced`. Optional names (`AUDIT_ROUNDS`, `PIVOT_INVALIDATION_LIST`) — not flagged when absent. Ticket with ZERO required anchors found → escalate to `BLOCKER` (dispatch impossible). Spec section names are author-discretionary → balance is checked by the STEP_1 mechanical pre-pass; no per-name coverage is enforced on specs.
